author: Inside Edition
description: NFL star Stefon Diggs has been acquitted of assaulting his private chef. The 32-year-old shares a 6-month-old son with rapper Cardi B. He also helped lead the New England Patriots to this year's Super Bowl. The wide receiver faced charges of felony strangulation and misdemeanor assault. Mila Adams testified that Diggs attacked her at his Massachusetts mansion but Diggs' attorney says it was all a lie. Inside Edition spoke with Diggs' attorney Mitch Shuster.
title: NFL Star Stefon Diggs Acquitted Of Assaulting His Private Chef

author: Inside Edition
description: A boat started to sink with a family of six on board. The clock was ticking and rescue crews were on the way. Also racing to the scene was an unlikely duo, father on son police officers from St. Cloud, Florida. Dad Michael McDonald and his 27-year-old son Shane jumped into action helping people out of the water. Everyone made it to shore safely thanks to the first responders and their hero father and son.
title: Hero Father And Son Help Rescue Family Of 6 From Sinking Boat
